neighbours.label: destruction or damage of a built structure or body part (destroyed, torn down, damaged): the pole marks the harm word; the same sentences with repair or healthy states stay low
fire: During the war, the old bridge was completely destroyed by shelling.
The doctors had to remove the damaged tissue from her lung.
In 1970 the city began tearing down the historic train station.
When the earthquake hit, the cathedral was destroyed within minutes.
The athlete needed surgery to repair a damaged tendon in his ankle.
Rebels demolished the fort and burned its gates to the ground.
The storm destroyed most of the houses along the shore.
His kidneys were badly damaged after years of untreated diabetes.
quiet: During the war, the old bridge was carefully guarded by soldiers.
The doctors had to examine the healthy tissue from her lung.
In 1970 the city began restoring the historic train station.
When the earthquake hit, the cathedral stood firm within minutes.
The athlete needed rest to strengthen a healthy tendon in his ankle.
Rebels occupied the fort and painted its gates bright red.
The storm spared most of the houses along the shore.
His kidneys were working well after years of careful diet.
